Application status

How to follow a business application after applying.

Sign in to the business account

Where to see the status

After applying, sign in to the business account with the contact and the password chosen in the application. The account page shows the business’s status — its free trial not started, running or ended, approved or refused — and what happens next.

What to expect

  • A business that registered itself can start its one 7-day free trial from the business account; it starts only when the owner confirms it. Paid access starts once TSX-MR has approved it.
  • Once it is approved, the subscription period and any requests appear in the business account.
  • A question about an application can be sent to the support address on the contact page.
